arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّةِ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ.
transliteration: U'eethukumaa bikalimaatil-laahit-taammah, min kulli shaytaanin wa haammah, wa min kulli 'aynin laammah.
translation: I seek refuge for you two in the Perfect Words of Allah, from every devil and every poisonous pest, and from every harmful eye.
